findings: `learner.overview.text` presents the counting-rod account as a direct early use, then only broadly calls the origin disputed. Distinguish the attested Shang numeral form 亖 (four accumulated strokes) from the separate, competing interpretations of later 四. Present the counting-rod, breath/呬, and original-graph-of-泗 accounts as qualified alternatives; the cited book says the 泗 proposal lacks textual attestation. Keep the borrowing direction explicit: 四 is proposed as the original graph of 泗 and was later borrowed for “four.” Cite `X-e6d62080b1a5fc5178a4`, `X-e04dfa01cf4e0d166657`, and `X-4b62255296f832195814` as relevant.
